chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a shimmering rising sparkle on glassy bells climbs through the Lydian raised fourth and blooms into a held glowing chord, the forest lighting up as you enter}
positive_styles: G Lydian mode with the raised fourth
glassy bell and celesta lead, slow wondering phrases that hang on the raised fourth
sparkling glassy bell arpeggios of slow broken chords
breathy soft pad and warm low synth bass with long notes
barely-there percussion, a soft tap per bar and dewdrop ticks
enchanted bioluminescent forest town, dewy wonder, a hush full of soft glow
